description: A PHP class defining a custom form renderer for OA forms, extending HTML_QuickForm_Renderer_Array, with methods for rendering form groups, headers, HTML elements, and handling custom attributes and decorators.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Component_ArrayRenderer
classes.description: A custom form renderer class for OA forms, extending HTML_QuickForm_Renderer_Array, with methods for rendering form components, headers, HTML elements, and handling custom attributes and decorators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with optional parameters for collecting hidden fields and static labels.

methods.name: startForm
methods.description: Initializes form rendering, storing form ID, required fields, and jQuery validation rules and methods.

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Begins rendering a form group, managing nested group stack and errors.

methods.name: finishGroup
methods.description: Completes rendering a form group, restoring previous group context.

methods.name: _storeArray
methods.description: Stores an element or group array into the appropriate part of the internal array structure.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders a header element, including icon and decorators, and stores it in sections.

methods.name: renderHtml
methods.description: Renders a raw HTML element, including decorators.

methods.name: _elementToArray
methods.description: Converts a form element into an array representation, including custom attributes, options, and decorators.

methods.name: setCustomAttribute
methods.description: Helper to add custom attributes to element array if present.

methods.name: decoratorsToArray
methods.description: Converts decorators of an element into an array with prepend, append, and list.
